from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import sys
import time
import warnings
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

warnings.simplefilter("ignore")      # the library's usage warning carries an instance URL

import numpy as np

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
K62 = HERE.parent / "hardware-62"
sys.path.insert(0, str(K62))
import hw_62 as H62  # noqa: E402  Kickoff 62's survey code, unchanged (it sets its own paths to hardware-62)
import tabulate_history as TH  # noqa: E402  history 01's value comparison, unchanged (hardware-62's copy)

BACKEND = "ibm_fez"
TAG = "t19"
COPIES, SHOTS = 2, 2_000
SURVEY = ("S0", "S1")
EST_S, MARGIN = 4.0, 1.5             # t19-rule.md: Kickoff 62's survey as measured, 4 s; with the half-again margin, 6 s
CYCLE_MARGIN = timedelta(minutes=30)
STAMPS = HERE / "stamps-t19"
K62_SHA = {"hw_62.py": "see inputs", "analyse_62.py": "see inputs"}


def sha(p):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def now():
    return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())


def ts(s):
    return datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace("Z", "+00:00")).astimezone(timezone.utc)


def log(msg, N):
    line = f"{now()} {msg}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    with (HERE / f"run-t19-d{N}.log").open("a") as f:
        f.write(line + "\n")






def meta():
    import qiskit
    import qiskit_ibm_runtime
    return {"script_sha256": sha(__file__), "hw_62_sha256": sha(K62 / "hw_62.py"), "hw_50_sha256": sha(K62 / "hw_50.py"),
            "hw_51_sha256": sha(K62 / "hw_51.py"), "manacitra_wait_sha256": sha(K62 / "site/manacitra/wait.py"),
            "tabulate_history_sha256": sha(K62 / "tabulate_history.py"),
            "qiskit": qiskit.__version__, "qiskit_ibm_runtime": qiskit_ibm_runtime.__version__, "numpy": np.__version__, "utc": now()}


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- stamps and published tables
def stamp_snapshot(backend, refresh=True):
    """Read the backend's properties; save the snapshot under its stamp if new. Returns (stamp_utc, file name, props dict)."""
    STAMPS.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    p = backend.properties(refresh=refresh)
    s = p.last_update_date.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    name = f"snapshot-{s.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}.json"
    d = json.loads(json.dumps(p.to_dict(), default=str))
    path = STAMPS / name
    if not path.exists():
        path.write_text(json.dumps(d, indent=1) + "\n")
    return s.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), name, d, p


def record_stamp(N, backend, kind, job_status=""):
    st, name, d, p = stamp_snapshot(backend)
    rp = HERE / f"stamps-t19-d{N}.json"
    rows = json.loads(rp.read_text()) if rp.exists() else []
    new = not rows or rows[-1]["snapshot"] != name
    row = {"utc": now(), "kind": kind, "stamp_utc": st, "snapshot": name, "new_stamp_since_last_row": new, "job_status": job_status}
    if new and rows:
        prev = STAMPS / rows[-1]["snapshot"]
        c = TH.compare(TH.load(prev), TH.load(STAMPS / name))
        row["changed"] = {k: c[k] for k in ("q_T1", "q_T2", "q_readout_error", "cz_error")}
    rows.append(row)
    rp.write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=1))
    return row, d, p


def published_table(props_dict, qs):
    """readout_error, prob_meas1_prep0 and prob_meas0_prep1 of every qubit read, from a saved snapshot."""
    out = {}
    for q in qs:
        v = {x["name"]: x["value"] for x in props_dict["qubits"][int(q)]}
        out[str(q)] = {k: (None if v.get(k) is None else float(v[k])) for k in ("readout_error", "prob_meas1_prep0", "prob_meas0_prep1")}
    return out


def operational(props, n):
    ops = {q: bool(props.is_qubit_operational(q)) for q in range(n)}
    return sorted(q for q, o in ops.items() if o), sorted(q for q, o in ops.items() if not o)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- window and cycle
def window_and_cycle(t=None):
    t = t or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    w = json.loads((HERE / "window-t19.json").read_text())
    out = {"utc": t.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"), "window": w["window"], "cycle": w["cycle"]}
    inside = False
    if w["window"].get("applies"):
        inside = ts(w["window"]["from_utc"]) <= t <= ts(w["window"]["to_utc"])
    out["inside_computed_window"] = inside
    c = w["cycle"]
    if c["latest_T1_stamp_utc"] is None:
        # ruling 5: no stamp in the 48 hours changed T1 on more than half the qubits; no cycle, no bar
        cyc_ok = True
        out["cycle_reading"] = "no T1 stamp in the 48 hours; no cycle in progress (ruling 5)"
    else:
        cyc_ok = bool(c["cycle_complete_in_48h"]) and t >= ts(c["submissions_from_utc"])
        out["cycle_reading"] = "cycle complete and 30 minutes past its CZ stamp" if cyc_ok else "cycle in progress or within 30 minutes of its CZ stamp"
    out["cycle_complete_and_margin_passed"] = cyc_ok
    out["pass"] = (not inside) and cyc_ok
    return out


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- the build
def build(backend, qs):
    circ = {k: H62.made(H62.survey_logical(k, len(qs)), qs, backend, k) for k in SURVEY}
    keyed = {(k, None, 0): c for k, c in circ.items()}
    rec, ok = H62.survey_checks(keyed, qs, backend)
    return circ, rec, ok


def assemble(circ, qs, N):
    items = [(k, cp) for k in SURVEY for cp in range(1, COPIES + 1)]
    perm = np.random.default_rng(1900 + N).permutation(len(items))
    circs, labels, shots = [], [], []
    for i in perm:
        k, cp = items[i]
        circs.append(circ[k])
        labels.append({"test": "t19", "date": N, "circuit": k, "copy": cp, "n_qubits_read": len(qs), "qubits_read": qs,
                       "clbits": "clbit i holds qubits_read[i]"})
        shots.append(SHOTS)
    return circs, labels, shots, [int(x) for x in perm]


def sampler(backend):
    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import SamplerV2
    s = SamplerV2(mode=backend)
    s.options.environment.job_tags = [TAG]
    s.options.dynamical_decoupling.enable = False
    s.options.twirling.enable_gates = False
    s.options.twirling.enable_measure = False
    so = s.options
    opt = {"dynamical_decoupling_enable": so.dynamical_decoupling.enable, "twirling_enable_gates": so.twirling.enable_gates,
           "twirling_enable_measure": so.twirling.enable_measure, "job_tags": list(so.environment.job_tags),
           "readout_error_mitigation": "none (SamplerV2 applies none)"}
    return s, opt


def live_build(N, kind):
    b = service().backend(BACKEND)
    row, d, p = record_stamp(N, b, kind)
    qs, notop = operational(p, b.num_qubits)
    circ, recs, ok = build(b, qs)
    circs, labels, shots, perm = assemble(circ, qs, N)
    dig = {k: H62.digest(c) for k, c in circ.items()}
    cfg = b.configuration()
    used = set().union(*[set(c.count_ops()) for c in circs])
    lim = {"max_shots": cfg.max_shots, "max_experiments": cfg.max_experiments, "n_positions": len(circs),
           "within": max(shots) <= cfg.max_shots and len(circs) <= cfg.max_experiments,
           "instructions_not_in_target": sorted(used - set(b.target.operation_names) - {"barrier", "delay"})}
    smp, sopt = sampler(b)
    ok = (ok and lim["within"] and not lim["instructions_not_in_target"] and sopt["dynamical_decoupling_enable"] is False
          and sopt["twirling_enable_gates"] is False and sopt["twirling_enable_measure"] is False and sopt["job_tags"] == [TAG]
          and sum(shots) == 8_000 and len(circs) == 4)
    rec = {"meta": meta(), "date": N, "backend": b.name, "n_qubits_processor": b.num_qubits, "qubits_read": qs,
           "not_operational_listed_not_read": notop, "stamp_row": row, "checks": recs, "circuit_digests": dig, "labels": labels,
           "shots": shots, "order_seed": 1900 + N, "order_permutation": perm, "limits": lim, "sampler_options": sopt, "all_pass": ok}
    return b, smp, circs, labels, shots, rec, d


def do_check(N):
    p = HERE / f"check-t19-d{N}.json"
    if p.exists():
        sys.exit("refusing: the check is already recorded for this date")
    b, smp, circs, labels, shots, rec, _ = live_build(N, f"d{N} build (check)")
    p.write_text(json.dumps(rec, indent=1, default=str))
    s0, s1 = rec["checks"]["S0"], rec["checks"]["S1"]
    log(f"d{N} check: {len(rec['qubits_read'])} qubits read, not operational {rec['not_operational_listed_not_read']}; S0 no gate {s0.get('no_gate')}, "
        f"S1 one X per qubit {s1.get('one_x_per_qubit')}; own bit {s0['qubit_i_into_clbit_i'] and s1['qubit_i_into_clbit_i']}; exact P1 S0 {s0['exact_P1_min_max']} S1 {s1['exact_P1_min_max']}; "
        f"limits {rec['limits']}; sampler {rec['sampler_options']}; stamp {rec['stamp_row']['stamp_utc']}; all {rec['all_pass']}", N)
    if not rec["all_pass"]:
        sys.exit("STOP: a structural check failed; nothing submitted")








def do_poll(N, jid):
    svc = service()
    j = svc.job(jid)
    b = svc.backend(BACKEND)
    while True:
        s = str(j.status())
        row, _, _ = record_stamp(N, b, f"d{N} poll", s)
        line = f"{now()} status {s}; stamp {row['stamp_utc']}{' NEW' if row['new_stamp_since_last_row'] else ''}"
        print(line, flush=True)
        with (HERE / f"poll-t19-d{N}.log").open("a") as f:
            f.write(line + "\n")
        if any(x in s for x in ("DONE", "ERROR", "CANCELLED")):
            return
        time.sleep(300)
        j = svc.job(jid)


def do_fetch(N, jid):
    svc = service()
    j = svc.job(jid)
    st = str(j.status())
    log(f"d{N} job {jid} status {st}", N)
    sub = json.loads((HERE / f"submit-t19-d{N}.json").read_text())
    assert sub["job_id"] == jid
    mt = j.metrics()
    use = mt.get("usage") or {}
    for x in use.get("details", []):
        (x.get("metric") or {}).pop("id", None)
    try:
        opts = j.inputs.get("options")
    except Exception:
        opts = None
    after, d_after, _ = record_stamp(N, svc.backend(BACKEND), f"d{N} after fetch", st)
    out = {"meta": meta(), "date": N, "job_id": jid, "status": st, "timestamps": mt.get("timestamps"), "usage": clean(use),
           "execution_metadata": None, "job_options_as_recorded_by_ibm": clean(opts),
           "stamp_at_submission": sub["stamp_row"]["stamp_utc"], "stamp_after_fetch": after["stamp_utc"],
           "labels": sub["labels"], "shots": sub["shots"], "counts": None}
    if "DONE" in st:
        res = j.result()
        out["counts"] = [res[k].data.c.get_counts() for k in range(len(sub["labels"]))]
        md = getattr(res, "metadata", None)
        out["execution_metadata"] = clean(json.loads(json.dumps(md, default=str))) if md is not None else None
        out["pub_metadata"] = [clean(json.loads(json.dumps(res[k].metadata, default=str))) for k in range(len(sub["labels"]))]
    (HERE / f"results-t19-d{N}-counts.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, default=str))
    log(f"d{N} fetched: status {st}; counts {'present' if out['counts'] else 'absent'}; charged {use.get('quantum_seconds') or use.get('qpu_charge_time_seconds')}; "
        f"stamp after fetch {after['stamp_utc']}", N)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--date", type=int, required=True)
    for f in ("--check", "--decision", "--submit", "--go"):
        ap.add_argument(f, action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--poll")
    ap.add_argument("--fetch")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    if a.check:
        do_check(a.date)
    if a.decision:
        do_decision(a.date)
    if a.submit:
        do_submit(a.date, a.go)
    if a.poll:
        do_poll(a.date, a.poll)
    if a.fetch:
        do_fetch(a.date, a.fetch)

desk_t19.py.text:
"""Test 19, section 10: the runner's desk check after the hash, with Kickoff 62's own measured values as the chip.

Each synthetic chip: the true P(1|0), P(0|1) of each qubit are Kickoff 62's pooled measured values;
4,000 shots per state are drawn binomially; e and se are computed as section 4 states; the synthetic
published value p is the true e plus the case's offset. 200 chips per case.

Readings that section 10 leaves open are run as variants and all reported:
  roles  : 'k62'    each qubit keeps the role it had on 15 October (case 2 only)
           'random' roles are reassigned at random on each chip
  floor  : 'none'   p may fall below 0 (the offsets applied as stated)
           'zero'   p is clipped at 0
Case 2's 37 qubits 'between' take offsets uniform in (0.01, 0.05), the range 15 October's 37 occupied
(0.0112 to 0.0493). Case 3's other half tracks within 0.003. Case 4's 30 qubits take offsets uniform in
(0.06, 0.43), the rest track within 0.003. Case 5 is not run here: see the report.
Usage: desk_t19.py SURVEY_62_JSON OUT_JSON
"""
import json, sys, hashlib
import numpy as np
from t19_classes import measured, qubit_class, date_word, SHOTS

SEED = 19010
CHIPS = 200

src = sys.argv[1]
raw = open(src, "rb").read()
sv = json.loads(raw)
keys = sorted(sv["qubits"], key=int)
P10 = np.array([sv["qubits"][k]["P1_given_0"] for k in keys])
P01 = np.array([sv["qubits"][k]["P0_given_1"] for k in keys])
E = (P10 + P01) / 2
PUB = np.array([sv["qubits"][k]["published"]["readout_error"] for k in keys])
D62 = PUB - E
n = len(keys)
role62 = np.where(D62 > 0.05, "gap", np.where(np.abs(D62) <= 0.01, "within",
                  np.where(D62 < -0.01, "below", "between")))
counts62 = {r: int((role62 == r).sum()) for r in ["gap", "within", "between", "below"]}
assert counts62 == {"gap": 105, "within": 13, "between": 37, "below": 1}, counts62


def offsets(case, rng, roles):
    off = rng.uniform(-0.003, 0.003, n)  # tracking within 0.003
    if case == 1:
        return off
    if case == 2:
        r = role62 if roles == "k62" else rng.permutation(role62)
        off[r == "gap"] = rng.uniform(0.06, 0.43, (r == "gap").sum())
        off[r == "between"] = rng.uniform(0.01, 0.05, (r == "between").sum())
        off[r == "below"] = -0.02
        return off
    if case == 3:
        half = rng.choice(n, n // 2, replace=False)
        sign = rng.choice([-1.0, 1.0], n // 2)
        off[half] = sign * rng.uniform(0.06, 0.20, n // 2)
        return off
    if case == 4:
        sel = rng.choice(n, 30, replace=False)
        off[sel] = rng.uniform(0.06, 0.43, 30)
        return off
    raise ValueError(case)


def run(case, roles, floor, rng):
    words, pa_l, ma_l = [], [], []
    for _ in range(CHIPS):
        k10 = rng.binomial(SHOTS, P10); k01 = rng.binomial(SHOTS, P01)
        p = E + offsets(case, rng, roles)
        if floor == "zero":
            p = np.maximum(p, 0.0)
        cls = []
        for i in range(n):
            e, se = measured(k10[i] / SHOTS, k01[i] / SHOTS)
            cls.append(qubit_class(p[i] - e, se))
        words.append(date_word(cls))
        pa_l.append(cls.count("PUBLISHED ABOVE")); ma_l.append(cls.count("MEASURED ABOVE"))
    tally = {w: words.count(w) for w in ["ONE-SIDED GAP", "TABLE DESCRIBES THE DEVICE", "MIXED"]}
    return {"case": case, "roles": roles, "floor": floor, "chips": CHIPS, "words": tally,
            "median_published_above": float(np.median(pa_l)), "median_measured_above": float(np.median(ma_l))}


REQUIRED = {1: "TABLE DESCRIBES THE DEVICE", 2: "ONE-SIDED GAP", 3: "MIXED"}
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
rows = []
for case in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
    for floor in ["none", "zero"]:
        for roles in (["k62", "random"] if case == 2 else ["n/a"]):
            r = run(case, roles, floor, rng)
            if case in REQUIRED:
                r["required_word"] = REQUIRED[case]
                r["rate"] = r["words"][REQUIRED[case]] / CHIPS
                r["met"] = r["rate"] >= 0.95
            rows.append(r)
            print(json.dumps(r))
out = {"rule": "t19-rule.md section 10, the runner's check after the hash", "seed": SEED,
       "chip_source": "Kickoff 62 survey (survey-62.json)", "chip_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
       "n_qubits": n, "chip_e_median": float(np.median(E)), "k62_roles": counts62,
       "rows": rows, "all_required_met": all(r["met"] for r in rows if "met" in r)}
json.dump(out, open(sys.argv[2], "w"), indent=1)
print("ALL REQUIRED MET:", out["all_required_met"])

"""Test 19, section 10, case 5 under the author's ruling 1 (15 November 2026 UTC).

On each synthetic chip the published table is Kickoff 62's own measured values e dealt out to the
qubits in a random order; the measured values are drawn as in desk_t19.py (4,000 shots per state from
Kickoff 62's pooled P(1|0) and P(0|1)). 200 chips. Seed 19015, recorded in rulings-t19.md before this ran.
Recorded case: no required rate.
Usage: desk_t19_case5.py SURVEY_62_JSON OUT_JSON
"""
import json, sys, hashlib
import numpy as np
from t19_classes import measured, qubit_class, date_word, SHOTS

SEED = 19015
CHIPS = 200
raw = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
sv = json.loads(raw)
keys = sorted(sv["qubits"], key=int)
P10 = np.array([sv["qubits"][k]["P1_given_0"] for k in keys])
P01 = np.array([sv["qubits"][k]["P0_given_1"] for k in keys])
E = (P10 + P01) / 2
n = len(keys)
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
words, pa_l, ma_l = [], [], []
for _ in range(CHIPS):
    k10 = rng.binomial(SHOTS, P10); k01 = rng.binomial(SHOTS, P01)
    p = rng.permutation(E)
    cls = []
    for i in range(n):
        e, se = measured(k10[i] / SHOTS, k01[i] / SHOTS)
        cls.append(qubit_class(p[i] - e, se))
    words.append(date_word(cls))
    pa_l.append(cls.count("PUBLISHED ABOVE")); ma_l.append(cls.count("MEASURED ABOVE"))
row = {"case": 5, "construction": "Kickoff 62 measured e dealt to the qubits in a random order (ruling 1)",
       "chips": CHIPS, "words": {w: words.count(w) for w in ["ONE-SIDED GAP", "TABLE DESCRIBES THE DEVICE", "MIXED"]},
       "median_published_above": float(np.median(pa_l)), "median_measured_above": float(np.median(ma_l)),
       "range_published_above": [int(min(pa_l)), int(max(pa_l))], "range_measured_above": [int(min(ma_l)), int(max(ma_l))]}
out = {"rule": "t19-rule.md section 10, case 5, ruling 1", "seed": SEED, "chip_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "row": row}
json.dump(out, open(sys.argv[2], "w"), indent=1)
print(json.dumps(row))

from __future__ import annotations

import csv
import json
import statistics
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import walk_history as WH  # noqa: E402  history 01's walk, unchanged
import tabulate_history as TH  # noqa: E402  history 01's comparison, unchanged

OUT = HERE / "history-55"
MARGIN = timedelta(minutes=30)


def z(dt):
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")




def pattern(group):
    """Per UTC day, the stamps of one group; the day-to-day intervals; the next expected stamp."""
    by_day = defaultdict(list)
    for s in group:
        by_day[s.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")].append(s)
    one_per_day = all(len(v) == 1 for v in by_day.values())
    intervals = [(b - a).total_seconds() for a, b in zip(group, group[1:])]
    out = {"stamps_utc": [z(s) for s in group], "per_utc_day": {d: [z(s) for s in v] for d, v in sorted(by_day.items())},
           "one_per_utc_day": one_per_day, "intervals_s": intervals,
           "intervals_h": [round(x / 3600, 3) for x in intervals]}
    if len(group) >= 2:
        mean = statistics.mean(intervals)
        out["mean_interval_s"] = mean
        out["mean_interval_h"] = round(mean / 3600, 4)
        out["next_expected_utc"] = z(group[-1] + timedelta(seconds=mean))
    else:
        out["next_expected_utc"] = None
    return out




if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Calibration history 01, section 2: walk ibm_fez's published properties from 2026-10-09 00:00 UTC to now.

Read-only. Reads backend properties through the instance named <instance>, one dated read per call. No job, no sampler,
no estimator. Prints and writes only stamps, timings and IBM's published properties; never account details.

1. Steps from START to now in 10-minute steps, calling properties(datetime=t) at each step.
2. Where the returned stamp changes between two steps, bisects the interval down to 1 minute.
3. At most one call per second. On an error, waits and retries up to 3 times with growing waits; if it persists,
   the walk stops. Stops after 45 minutes of calls.
4. Saves each distinct snapshot's full to_dict() as JSON, named by its stamp, in snapshots/.

Writes stamps.csv (every call) and walk-01.json (coverage and limits).
"""
import csv
import json
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from pathlib import Path

START = datetime(2026, 10, 9, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
STEP = timedelta(minutes=10)
FINE = timedelta(minutes=1)
MIN_GAP_S = 1.0
RETRY_WAITS_S = (10, 30, 90)
TIME_LIMIT_S = 45 * 60
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SNAP = HERE / "snapshots"
FIELDS = ["call", "phase", "asked_utc", "called_utc", "returned_utc", "returned_raw", "retries", "error"]


class Stop(Exception):
    pass


def utc(dt):
    return dt.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def iso(dt):
    return utc(dt).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


class Walker:
    def __init__(self, backend, writer, fh):
        self.b, self.w, self.fh = backend, writer, fh
        self.n, self.t0, self.last_call = 0, time.monotonic(), 0.0
        self.seen, self.retry_log, self.cache = {}, [], {}

    def elapsed(self):
        return time.monotonic() - self.t0

    def ask(self, t, phase):
        """Stamp (UTC datetime) of the properties closest to, but older than, t."""
        if t in self.cache:
            return self.cache[t]
        if self.elapsed() > TIME_LIMIT_S:
            raise Stop(f"time limit of {TIME_LIMIT_S // 60} minutes reached")
        retries, err = 0, ""
        while True:
            wait = MIN_GAP_S - (time.monotonic() - self.last_call)
            if wait > 0:
                time.sleep(wait)
            self.last_call = time.monotonic()
            called = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
            try:
                p = self.b.properties(datetime=t)
                break
            except Exception as e:  # rate limit, server or network error: wait and retry
                err = f"{type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:200]}"
                self.retry_log.append({"asked_utc": iso(t), "called_utc": iso(called), "error": err})
                if retries >= len(RETRY_WAITS_S):
                    self.row(t, phase, called, None, None, retries, err)
                    raise Stop(f"error persisted after {retries} retries at asked {iso(t)}: {err}")
                time.sleep(RETRY_WAITS_S[retries])
                retries += 1
        self.n += 1
        if p is None:
            self.row(t, phase, called, None, None, retries, "properties returned None")
            self.cache[t] = None
            return None
        s = utc(p.last_update_date)
        self.row(t, phase, called, s, str(p.last_update_date), retries, err if retries else "")
        if s not in self.seen:
            name = f"snapshot-{s.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}.json"
            (SNAP / name).write_text(json.dumps(p.to_dict(), default=str, indent=1) + "\n")
            self.seen[s] = name
            print(f"[{self.elapsed():7.1f}s] call {self.n}: new stamp {iso(s)} (asked {iso(t)}, {phase})", flush=True)
        self.cache[t] = s
        return s

    def row(self, t, phase, called, s, raw, retries, err):
        self.w.writerow({"call": self.n, "phase": phase, "asked_utc": iso(t), "called_utc": iso(called),
                         "returned_utc": iso(s) if s else "", "returned_raw": raw or "", "retries": retries,
                         "error": err})
        self.fh.flush()

    def bisect(self, lo, a, hi, b):
        """Stamps a at lo and b at hi differ; narrow to intervals of at most 1 minute."""
        if hi - lo <= FINE:
            return
        mid = lo + timedelta(seconds=int((hi - lo).total_seconds() // 2))
        m = self.ask(mid, "bisect")
        if m != a:
            self.bisect(lo, a, mid, m)
        if m != b:
            self.bisect(mid, m, hi, b)




if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Calibration history 01, section 3: tabulate the distinct properties stamps found by walk_history.py.

Offline. Reads snapshots/*.json (IBM's published properties for ibm_fez) and walk-01.json; makes no network call.
Compares values, not dates, between each snapshot and the one before it. Descriptive only.

Writes changes.csv (one row per distinct stamp), param-dates.csv (per snapshot, parameter and date: how many qubits
carry that date) and tables-01.json (everything the report's tables and summaries are built from).
"""
import csv
import json
import statistics
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SNAP = HERE / "snapshots"
NY = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")
WINDOW_START = datetime(2026, 10, 9, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
QUBIT_PARAMS = ["T1", "T2", "frequency", "readout_error", "prob_meas0_prep1", "prob_meas1_prep0"]
DATE_PARAMS = ["T1", "T2", "readout_error"]
ONE_Q_GATES = ["id", "rx", "rz", "sx", "x", "xslow"]
N_QUBITS = 156


def ts(s):
    """IBM date string (any offset) to an aware UTC datetime."""
    return datetime.fromisoformat(s).astimezone(timezone.utc)


def z(dt):
    return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def hm(seconds):
    m = round(seconds / 60)
    return f"{m // 60}h{m % 60:02d}m"


def load(path):
    d = json.loads(path.read_text())
    q = {}
    for i, params in enumerate(d["qubits"]):
        q[i] = {p["name"]: (p["value"], p["date"]) for p in params}
    g1, cz = defaultdict(dict), defaultdict(dict)
    for g in d["gates"]:
        ps = {p["name"]: (p["value"], p["date"]) for p in g["parameters"]}
        if g["gate"] in ONE_Q_GATES and len(g["qubits"]) == 1:
            g1[g["qubits"][0]][g["gate"]] = ps.get("gate_error", (None, None))[0]
        elif g["gate"] == "cz":
            e = tuple(sorted(g["qubits"]))
            cz[e][tuple(g["qubits"])] = (ps.get("gate_error", (None, None))[0], ps.get("gate_length", (None, None))[0])
    return {"stamp": ts(d["last_update_date"]), "raw_stamp": d["last_update_date"], "file": path.name,
            "qubits": q, "g1": g1, "cz": cz, "n_qubits": len(d["qubits"])}


LISTED = {f"qubit.{n}" for n in QUBIT_PARAMS} | {f"gate.{g}.gate_error" for g in ONE_Q_GATES} | {
    "gate.cz.gate_error", "gate.cz.gate_length"}


def flat(path):
    """Every published value and date in a snapshot, keyed by (category, entry)."""
    d = json.loads(path.read_text())
    vals, dates = {}, {}
    for i, params in enumerate(d["qubits"]):
        for p in params:
            k = (f"qubit.{p['name']}", i)
            vals[k], dates[k] = p["value"], p["date"]
    for g in d["gates"]:
        for p in g["parameters"]:
            k = (f"gate.{g['gate']}.{p['name']}", g["name"])
            vals[k], dates[k] = p["value"], p["date"]
    for p in d["general"]:
        k = (f"general.{p['name'].split('_')[0]}", p["name"])
        vals[k], dates[k] = p["value"], p["date"]
    for p in d.get("general_qlists", []):
        vals[("general_qlists.lf_chain", p["name"])] = tuple(p["qubits"])
    return vals, dates


def other_changes(prev_path, cur_path):
    """Values changed outside the listed columns, and dates moved in any field, by category."""
    pv, pd = flat(prev_path)
    cv, cd = flat(cur_path)
    vch = Counter(k[0] for k in set(pv) | set(cv) if pv.get(k) != cv.get(k))
    dch = Counter(k[0] for k in set(pd) | set(cd) if pd.get(k) != cd.get(k))
    fmt = lambda c: "; ".join(f"{k} {n}" for k, n in sorted(c.items()))
    return {"other_values_changed": fmt({k: n for k, n in vch.items() if k not in LISTED}),
            "any_value_changed": sum(vch.values()) > 0, "dates_moved": fmt(dch)}


def val(snap, i, name):
    return snap["qubits"].get(i, {}).get(name, (None, None))[0]


def compare(prev, cur):
    out = {}
    for name in QUBIT_PARAMS:
        out[f"q_{name}"] = sum(val(prev, i, name) != val(cur, i, name) for i in range(N_QUBITS))
    # carried in at least one snapshot: a qubit whose parameter is absent in both is not counted as changed
    out["q_any_of_six"] = sum(any(val(prev, i, n) != val(cur, i, n) for n in QUBIT_PARAMS) for i in range(N_QUBITS))
    for gname in ONE_Q_GATES:
        out[f"g1_{gname}"] = sum(prev["g1"][i].get(gname) != cur["g1"][i].get(gname) for i in range(N_QUBITS))
    out["g1_any"] = sum(prev["g1"][i] != cur["g1"][i] for i in range(N_QUBITS))
    edges = sorted(set(prev["cz"]) | set(cur["cz"]))
    out["cz_error"] = sum(any(prev["cz"][e].get(k, (None,))[0] != cur["cz"][e].get(k, (None,))[0]
                              for k in set(prev["cz"][e]) | set(cur["cz"][e])) for e in edges)
    out["cz_length"] = sum(any(prev["cz"][e].get(k, (None, None))[1] != cur["cz"][e].get(k, (None, None))[1]
                               for k in set(prev["cz"][e]) | set(cur["cz"][e])) for e in edges)
    out["cz_error_or_length"] = sum(prev["cz"][e] != cur["cz"][e] for e in edges)
    out["n_edges"] = len(edges)
    return out


def date_profile(snap, prev):
    """Per parameter: qubits carrying each distinct date, the range, and how many dates moved since prev."""
    prof = {}
    for name in DATE_PARAMS:
        dates = [snap["qubits"][i][name][1] for i in range(N_QUBITS) if name in snap["qubits"][i]]
        utc = [ts(d) for d in dates]
        moved = None
        if prev is not None:
            moved = sum(1 for i in range(N_QUBITS) if name in snap["qubits"][i]
                        and snap["qubits"][i][name][1] != prev["qubits"].get(i, {}).get(name, (None, None))[1])
        prof[name] = {"n_qubits": len(dates), "n_distinct_dates": len(set(dates)),
                      "earliest_utc": z(min(utc)), "latest_utc": z(max(utc)),
                      "qubits_with_date_after_prev_stamp": None if prev is None else sum(u > prev["stamp"] for u in utc),
                      "qubits_whose_date_changed": moved,
                      "per_date": Counter(z(u) for u in utc)}
    return prof


def main():
    walk = json.loads((HERE / "walk-01.json").read_text())
    snaps = [load(p) for p in sorted(SNAP.glob("snapshot-*.json"))]
    snaps.sort(key=lambda s: s["stamp"])
    assert all(s["n_qubits"] == N_QUBITS for s in snaps)

    rows, date_rows, prev = [], [], None
    for k, s in enumerate(snaps):
        r = {"n": k, "stamp_utc": z(s["stamp"]), "stamp_new_york": s["stamp"].astimezone(NY).strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"),
             "weekday_utc": s["stamp"].strftime("%a"), "weekday_new_york": s["stamp"].astimezone(NY).strftime("%a"),
             "in_window": s["stamp"] >= WINDOW_START, "file": s["file"],
             "since_prev": hm((s["stamp"] - prev["stamp"]).total_seconds()) if prev else "",
             "since_prev_s": int((s["stamp"] - prev["stamp"]).total_seconds()) if prev else ""}
        if prev is not None:
            r.update(compare(prev, s))
            r.update(other_changes(SNAP / prev["file"], SNAP / s["file"]))
        _, dates = flat(SNAP / s["file"])
        r["entries_dated_at_stamp"] = sum(ts(d) == s["stamp"] for d in dates.values())
        r["entries_dated_after_stamp"] = sum(ts(d) > s["stamp"] for d in dates.values())
        prof = date_profile(s, prev)
        for name in DATE_PARAMS:
            p = prof[name]
            r[f"{name}_n_distinct_dates"] = p["n_distinct_dates"]
            r[f"{name}_dates_earliest_utc"] = p["earliest_utc"]
            r[f"{name}_dates_latest_utc"] = p["latest_utc"]
            r[f"{name}_dates_after_prev_stamp"] = p["qubits_with_date_after_prev_stamp"]
            r[f"{name}_dates_changed"] = p["qubits_whose_date_changed"]
            for d, n in sorted(p["per_date"].items()):
                date_rows.append({"stamp_utc": z(s["stamp"]), "parameter": name, "date_utc": d, "n_qubits": n})
        rows.append(r)
        prev = s

    fields = list(dict.fromkeys(k for r in rows for k in r))
    with open(HERE / "changes.csv", "w", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=fields)
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(rows)
    with open(HERE / "param-dates.csv", "w", newline="") as fh:
        w = csv.DictWriter(fh, fieldnames=["stamp_utc", "parameter", "date_utc", "n_qubits"])
        w.writeheader()
        w.writerows(date_rows)

    win = [r for r in rows if r["in_window"]]
    intervals = [r["since_prev_s"] for r in win if r["since_prev_s"] != ""]
    per_day = Counter(r["stamp_utc"][:10] for r in win)
    per_hour = Counter(int(r["stamp_utc"][11:13]) for r in win)
    whole = [r for r in win if "q_T1" in r and (r["q_T1"] > N_QUBITS / 2 or r["q_readout_error"] > N_QUBITS / 2)]
    few = [r for r in win if "q_T1" in r and r not in whole]
    date_only = [r["stamp_utc"] for r in win if "q_T1" in r and not r["any_value_changed"]]
    half_q, half_e = N_QUBITS / 2, 176 / 2
    fam = {
        "T1 on more than 78 qubits": lambda r: r["q_T1"] > half_q,
        "single-qubit gate errors on more than 78 qubits": lambda r: r["g1_any"] > half_q,
        "CZ errors on more than 88 edges": lambda r: r["cz_error"] > half_e,
        "readout error on more than 78 qubits": lambda r: r["q_readout_error"] > half_q,
        "readout error on 1 to 78 qubits": lambda r: 0 < r["q_readout_error"] <= half_q,
        "layer-fidelity entries (general lf)": lambda r: "general.lf " in r["other_values_changed"] + " ",
        "other values only (none of the above)": None,
        "no value changed (dates only)": lambda r: not r["any_value_changed"],
    }
    families = {}
    for name, f in fam.items():
        if f is not None:
            families[name] = [r["stamp_utc"] for r in win if "q_T1" in r and f(r)]
    named = set().union(*(set(v) for v in families.values()))
    families["other values only (none of the above)"] = [r["stamp_utc"] for r in win if r["stamp_utc"] not in named]
    families = {k: families[k] for k in fam}
    tables = {"families": families, "n_snapshots": len(rows), "n_in_window": len(win), "walk": {k: walk[k] for k in walk if k != "distinct_stamps"},
              "per_day_utc": dict(sorted(per_day.items())), "per_hour_utc": {h: per_hour.get(h, 0) for h in range(24)},
              "intervals_s": {"min": min(intervals), "median": statistics.median(intervals), "max": max(intervals),
                              "all": intervals} if intervals else None,
              "most_of_chip": [r["stamp_utc"] for r in whole], "few": [r["stamp_utc"] for r in few],
              "no_value_changed": date_only,
              "params_carried": {n: sum(n in snaps[-1]["qubits"][i] for i in range(N_QUBITS)) for n in QUBIT_PARAMS},
              "rows": rows}
    (HERE / "tables-01.json").write_text(json.dumps(tables, indent=1, default=str) + "\n")
    print(f"{len(rows)} snapshots ({len(win)} in window); {len(whole)} most-of-chip, {len(few)} few")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
